selected_evidence.requirement: Live forwarding and required storage path
selected_evidence.summary: Node2 established the forwarding connection and node1 stored the exact test message in `/var/log/inventory/node2.log`.
Both rsyslog configurations validated successfully; node1 listened on TCP/514 with a persistent firewall rule restricted to node2.
Healthy baseline boot ID `be303eb3-…`, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID `bc5f258b-…`, recovered services/listener, preserved data, and fresh post-restart delivery were demonstrated.
Healthy baseline boot ID `8f258838-…`, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID `96c4eb23-…`, recovered forwarding connection, and successful post-restart message delivery were demonstrated.

cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/30-inventory-collector.conf <<'ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_COLLECTOR'
module(load="imtcp")

template(name="InventoryNode2Format" type="string"
         string="%timegenerated:::date-rfc3339% %hostname% %syslogtag%%msg%\n")

ruleset(name="inventory_from_node2") {
    if ($fromhost-ip == "10.100.71.11" and $programname == "inventory") then {
        action(type="omfile"
               file="/var/log/inventory/node2.log"
               createDirs="on"
               dirCreateMode="0750"
               fileCreateMode="0640"
               template="InventoryNode2Format")
        stop
    }
}

input(type="imtcp" port="514" ruleset="inventory_from_node2")
